cards.prompt:
Create ONE polished Chinese portrait promotional poster for a REAL casual MINI-GAME COLLECTION. Strict VERTICAL 9:16 canvas, ideally 1440 by 2560 pixels, full bleed, designed to remain immediately readable as a small 180×320 recommendation thumbnail. This is newly composed PORTRAIT art, NOT a landscape card placed on a tall page. Do not imitate earlier fruit-themed posters.
LAYOUT AND HIERARCHY: Comfortable 5 percent outer safety margins. Upper 25 percent holds a small centered brand line then a much larger TWO-LINE bold rounded Chinese headline, with clean negative space. Middle/lower 64 percent holds exactly FOUR equal-scale game scenes in a balanced 2×2 arrangement; all four worlds have comparable area, detail and visual weight. Each scene fits entirely inside its quadrant. A modest footer at bottom around 94 percent height carries exactly "休闲小游戏合集". Keep important artwork and all text inside safety margins. Large simple visual subjects with breathing room, no hundreds of tiny props. The game scenes communicate real gameplay, not abstract unrelated toys. No dominant hero game, no oversized mascot.
REFERENCE FOR THE CAT GAME: The supporting Meowdoku image is an actual gameplay screenshot. Use ONLY its white-framed colored-region puzzle board with small ragdoll CAT-HEAD tokens and white X elimination marks, and ignore ALL score, controls, hearts, Chinese UI labels and other screenshot UI. Show a compact simplified 6×6 board with connected pastel color regions and roughly four tiny cat-head tokens, some white Xs and empty cells. Each placed cat should occupy its own different row and column, not touch another cat even diagonally. The cat game is just ONE of four equal scenes. ALL cats remain small tokens INSIDE this board; no separate large kitten, no full-body cat, no large cat-face mascot. No Sudoku numbers on this colored cat board.
STRICT EXCLUSIONS across whole poster: NO bubble-shooter / bubble cannon / bubble boss characters, NO chess or xiangqi pieces, NO watermelon or fruit-merging imagery, NO fruit decorations. No gamepads, phone mockups, app controls, fake buttons, scores, prices, QR codes, logos or watermarks. No small-print promotional promises. Only the exact specified Chinese copy, plus legitimate digits on a numeric game board if that game is explicitly included. All four scenes fit safely below headline and above footer.
ART DIRECTION: Fresh sunny sky-blue and warm ivory portrait poster, peach and lavender local accents, crisp clean casual-game key art, gentle golden light. FOUR equal gameplay windows blend organically through cream cloud-shaped boundaries, no busy scenery behind the title, no chunky multicolored text outlines. Each of the four games feels large and complete within its equally sized quadrant.
EXACT COPY: Small bold dark-navy brand line at top "随手玩一把". Under it, a much larger bold rounded dark-navy headline on EXACTLY TWO lines, first line "多种玩法", second line "随心切换". Footer exactly "休闲小游戏合集", dark navy. No other writing.
TOP LEFT / ref1: tall miniature ivory modular skyscraper with blue window pairs, yellow crane suspending one floor above it with a visible small alignment gap, peach clouds and a softly distant blue city. This naturally tall subject fits portrait quadrant fully.
TOP RIGHT / ref2: central cyan ring linked with pink, purple, lime and orange OPEN C-shaped rings; rounded gaps, small connecting cuffs, one orange ring rotating free with one tiny gold spark. Keep glossy shapes crisp and big.
BOTTOM LEFT / ref3: ONLY compact pastel colored-region cat puzzle board with a thin white rounded frame, small cat-head tokens and white X marks as specified, same bounding size as the route board in bottom-right. No cat outside the board.
BOTTOM RIGHT / ref4: compact dark slate 4×4 square-cell route-filling board, coral / turquoise / blue / golden yellow regions with darker thick paths turning 90 degrees through adjacent cells and clear circular endpoints, no hand.
Balanced 2×2 worlds fill lower middle naturally; narrow pale cloud seams, restrained sparkles, no extra props. Overall message is variety of mini-games, not cats, Sudoku, rings or any single game.
